name: Metal Sentinel live metal widgets
description: Embeddable live widgets for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, nickel, aluminum, zinc, and lead in USD; already used by Alien/Infinity Radio.

verification.limits: Free embeddable widgets; not a JSON API

name: Internet Archive public search and metadata
description: Public search and retrieval for audio, video, books, metadata, and playable media used across Phi media flows.

verification.limits: Public archive/search source already used in Phi projects

name: MediaWiki / Wikipedia API
description: Public encyclopedia search, extracts, summaries, page data, and images.

verification.limits: Public MediaWiki endpoint already used by Phi projects

name: Crossref public REST API
description: Anonymous public scholarly metadata and DOI lookup. Code Phi uses only the public no-signup pool, never premium access.

verification.limits: Public pool; no signup; polite identification optional

name: Library of Congress JSON API
description: Public JSON/YAML access to Library of Congress collections, images, and metadata.

verification.limits: No key/auth; public rate limits apply

name: National Weather Service API
description: Open U.S. forecasts, alerts, and observations. NWS states the API is open data and charges no fees.

verification.limits: Free; reasonable rate limits; User-Agent required

name: USGS Earthquake GeoJSON and FDSN APIs
description: Programmatic earthquake feeds, event detail, and catalog queries.

name: BLS Public Data API v1
description: Unregistered public access to BLS time-series data. Code Phi uses v1 only; v2 registration is excluded.

name: DuckDuckGo Instant Answer endpoint
description: No-key instant-answer endpoint used as a lightweight supplemental source, not as a full web-search replacement.

name: GitHub public REST reads
description: Unauthenticated reads for public repository and commit data; Code Phi does not ask end users for a GitHub API key.

verification.limits: Unauthenticated public reads: 60 requests/hour per IP

name: Orange Brook SearXNG
description: Existing Phi search and image backend plus Code Phi plan and Cloud Browser inspection routes.

name: Podcast RSS 2.0 / Enclosure Metadata
description: Read public podcast RSS XML and titles, descriptions, optional artwork and enclosure links. Do not claim that public availability grants commercial embedding or redistribution rights. X/Facebook/Spotify pages are discovery links unless their official players support embeds.

verification.limits: Browser CORS varies by source; creator licensing and feed availability must be checked. No paid API or OAuth.

name: YouTube privacy-enhanced video and playlist embeds
description: Use video/playlist IDs from verified search selections, creator-provided URLs or publicly indexed sources. Official player loads only when clicked. Does not provide unauthenticated search of all YouTube videos.
auth: None for known public video IDs

verification.limits: Creator can disable embedding and age/region restrictions apply; YouTube search API needs authenticated access.

name: Vimeo public video embed
description: Render authorized embeddable Vimeo video URLs as a standard in-page provider player, never extracting or copying raw media.

verification.limits: Embeddability is controlled by video owner.
